context:
Goal: a lane that fixes its last review finding merges without hours of waiting.
Problem (rule): the three-round review cap says nothing about a fix landed after round 3, and the merge grant still needs a fresh reviewer on the head that merges, so a lane that fixes its round-3 finding lands on a head no rule lets anyone read.
Based on (incident): degen page item 83: five degen PRs held about 2 hours (degen D10, 14:56 CST).
Based on (read): CLAUDE.md rule roles-review-cap-three: 'A change gets at most three review rounds'; decision standing-merge-grant needs a reviewer's approval of the merged head.
Departs from: roles-review-cap-three, silent on a fix after round 3 — adds a one-read fix check.

options.gain: Lanes that fix their last finding merge the same hour, in every repo.
options.how: After the last round, any fix confined to that round's findings gets one fresh Sonnet read of the fix diff and the finding. Pass merges on green; fail holds for you. A plain merge of main needs no read.
options.label: Fix check in every repo
options.lose: One extra short read per late fix.

options.gain: The narrowest change that clears degen's hold.
options.how: Allow the fix check only for the two cases degen D10 named.
options.label: Only degen's two cases, made global
options.lose: Other late fixes still wait for you.

options.gain: No new step in the review flow.
options.how: Keep the rule as it is.
options.label: No change
options.lose: Late fixes keep holding PRs for hours.

ref: step late-review-fixes; lane session_013NEJL2mkqxZo8g998PyeoS report, branch late-review-fixes head 93af114c; degen page item 83
title: After the last review round, does a small fix get one short read and then merge?
why: A fix confined to the last findings is the outcome review asked for; one short read is enough to merge it.
